items.headline: Ross Stores reported Q1 FY2026 results that beat expectations, with revenue up 21% to $6.01 billion, same-store sales up 17%, and it raised its full-year outlook.
Ross Stores Q1 earnings coverage highlighted stronger-than-expected sales and comparable-store growth, with the stock rising more than 5% in after-hours trading.
Analyst coverage noted TD Cowen maintained a Buy rating on Ross Stores after executive discussions, indicating continued favorable sentiment.
